notes.note: Scoped delta review of the #4194 merge with origin/main (363d5befa7e, bringing #4127) and its follow-up 22c5d58fb89. #4127's own OrchestrationService changes in this delta are owned and reviewed by #4127. The branch's changed OrchestrationService lines are the conversation-open read (nextTurnStartsSession, now awaited with the request authority so it is omitted while a context-delivery fence would refuse the send) and the start-metadata read for sessionStarted replays. The capture shows the request inspection surface; none of those lines are on that path, so no recapture.
